summary: Iteration 6 - Bug fixes testing complete. All 3 reported issues have been fixed and verified: (1) Icon file upload works, (2) Driver go-online button enabled when checkbox checked, (3) Input icon spacing fixed with pl-14. Backend: 14/14 tests passed. Frontend: All UI tests passed.

backend_icon_upload: POST /api/settings/upload-icon with PNG file returns success and URL
Upload endpoint requires authentication (401 without token)
Upload rejects invalid file formats (400 for non-images)
backend_driver_toggle_ready: Toggle-ready actually toggles the online status
Toggle-ready requires driver role (403 for customers)
backend_admin_settings: Admin can change app_name via POST /api/settings/
backend_auth_flows: Customer auth flow with test code 1234 works
Driver auth flow with test code 1234 works
Admin login with admin@taxi.local / admin123 works
frontend_icon_upload: Admin Settings tab shows 'Загрузить иконку' button (data-testid='settings-app-icon-upload')
No URL text input for icon (replaced with upload button)
frontend_driver_go_online: Button is disabled when rules checkbox unchecked
Button is ENABLED after checking rules checkbox
No balance requirement blocking the button
frontend_auth_flows: Customer auth with test code 1234 redirects to /customer
Driver auth with test code 1234 redirects to /driver

critical_code_review_comments: Icon upload endpoint properly validates file types and size (max 2MB)
Uploaded files stored in /app/backend/uploads/ and served via /api/uploads/ static mount
Driver toggle-ready no longer checks balance on frontend - only requires agreedRules checkbox
Input spacing fixed by using !pl-14 with important flag and splitting padding properties in CSS
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created - used existing test users
